overrides.replacement_claim: Aggregate sprint projections used by the performance status API, server-rendered workbench, and TUI omit durable operational lifecycle and cancellation state because they bypass the enriched PerformanceStatus use case.
overrides.reason: Both theories describe the same projection defect. The aggregate helper delegates directly to the state projection, the sprint summary stores that result, and the API and presentation surfaces consume it without durable-run enrichment.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance evidence endpoint has a compatibility path that returns an unversioned ad hoc artifact payload instead of PerformanceEvidenceResult.
overrides.reason: The handler explicitly emits attempt_id, artifacts, and returned_count without schema_version, records, or next_cursor when the separately optional evidence query capability is absent.

overrides.replacement_claim: The public performance configuration table documents supported hard maxima above values accepted by runtime validation.
overrides.reason: The documentation lists several hard maxima above defaults, while validation uses each default as the upper acceptance ceiling.

overrides.replacement_claim: PerformanceResult returns an unclassified raw error when no terminal result exists, bypassing performance-specific transport mapping.
overrides.reason: The unavailable-result branch returns a plain error, while the HTTP performance mapping recognizes only PerformanceUseCaseError values.

overrides.replacement_claim: The shared operation runner discards errors returned by performanceSettings, but supplied evidence does not establish an executable caller path that can construct the runner with invalid effective configuration.
overrides.reason: The discarded error is explicit, but the confirmation condition also requires reachability past caller-side configuration validation. The retained investigator tests reported failure-signature mismatches and do not establish that behavior.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance CLI maps every non-cancellation performance failure to ExitValidation regardless of its classified category.
overrides.reason: The command writer handles context cancellation separately and unconditionally wraps every other failure with ExitValidation, collapsing distinct operational signals.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance failure finalization path can publish flow state after its verification writer token becomes stale because it does not recheck the writer fence immediately before SaveFlowState.
overrides.reason: Both theories identify the same race. The failure path performs fenced state publication and then saves flow state without the immediate writer check present in the normal success path.

overrides.replacement_claim: ValidateRepairReverification does not validate nested performance TargetResults.
overrides.reason: Persisted repair performance records contain TargetResults, but the validator's performance branch checks only top-level authority, outcome, cleanup, and text fields before returning success.

overrides.replacement_claim: The JSON performance-output parser accepts malformed trailing content after a valid envelope.
overrides.reason: The parser rejects a second decoded JSON value but accepts every second-decode error rather than requiring io.EOF, so malformed trailing syntax is accepted.

overrides.replacement_claim: The supplied criteria do not prohibit public exposure of bounded evidence-reference paths and digests, and the documented performance surfaces expressly expose bounded evidence references and metadata while withholding raw evidence.
overrides.reason: The evidence proves that paths and digests are serialized, but it does not establish the claimed prohibition. The supplied documentation distinguishes bounded references and metadata from raw samples, output, profiles, patches, prompts, environment values, and secrets.

overrides.replacement_claim: The TUI exposes mutating performance actions when policy is disabled but a historical attempt exists.
overrides.reason: The navigation condition admits either enabled policy or an existing attempt, then always adds start and adds resume, cancel, and recover for an existing attempt. The supplied disabled-state test omits a historical attempt.

overrides.replacement_claim: Disabled-policy requirements validation falsely reports a performance policy mismatch for fenced or HTML-commented pseudo Performance Targets headings.
overrides.reason: Both theories describe the same declaration-detection defect. Target parsing ignores pseudo-sections, but the separate heading-presence check does not track fence or comment context and triggers the mismatch.

overrides.replacement_claim: Performance manifest discovery accepts descriptor markers separated from their function declaration by blank lines or comments.
overrides.reason: The discovery loop retains a pending marker while skipping blank and comment lines, contrary to its explicit immediate-precedence contract.

overrides.replacement_claim: Performance product defaults and lower-only workflow validation are implemented in the generic platform config package.
overrides.reason: The platform package defines performance-domain defaults and validation policy, while the architecture criterion explicitly reserves product-specific defaults and validation rules for the owning product module.

issues.claim: Aggregate performance projections omit durable operational lifecycle and cancellation state.
issues.title: Performance surfaces omit durable run state
issues.reason: Sprint summaries use the raw performance state projection, and the API, HTML workbench, and TUI consume that summary instead of the durable-run-enriched status use case.

issues.claim: Missing performance results bypass performance-specific error classification.
issues.title: Unavailable result returns an unclassified error
issues.reason: The raw error falls through the performance transport mapping and loses the intended stable performance code and category.

issues.claim: Persisted repair performance target results are accepted without nested validation.
issues.title: Repair reverification accepts malformed target results
issues.reason: Malformed target identities, qualifications, or comparison outcomes can survive top-level persisted-state validation.

issues.claim: Disabled historical performance states expose mutating TUI actions.
issues.title: TUI exposes mutations for disabled performance policy
issues.reason: Historical visibility is conflated with mutation eligibility, exposing start, resume, cancel, and recover actions under disabled policy.

issues.claim: Product-specific performance defaults and validation reside in platform config.
issues.title: Platform config contains performance business policy
issues.reason: The generic platform layer owns bounded-context defaults and lower-only workflow rules prohibited by the architecture contract.

issues.claim: Documented performance hard maxima are rejected by configuration validation.
issues.title: Performance limit documentation contradicts validation
issues.reason: Operators are told that values above defaults are supported even though loading rejects them.

issues.claim: Failure finalization can save flow state without current verification-writer ownership.
issues.title: Failure flow publication lacks final writer fence
issues.reason: Ownership may change after fenced performance-state publication and before the unfenced SaveFlowState call, allowing stale flow authority to be published.

issues.claim: The evidence endpoint can return an unversioned payload incompatible with PerformanceEvidenceResult.
issues.title: Evidence compatibility response breaks schema
issues.reason: A supported optional-capability branch emits a different, unversioned response shape.

issues.claim: The performance CLI collapses all non-cancellation failures into the validation exit class.
issues.title: Performance CLI loses failure exit categories
issues.reason: Runtime, timeout, dependency, persistence, configuration, and validation failures receive the same CLI exit behavior.

issues.claim: Malformed trailing JSON after a valid performance envelope is accepted.
issues.title: Performance JSON parser accepts malformed trailing data
issues.reason: The second decode is not required to return io.EOF, weakening the closed output schema.

issues.claim: Pseudo Performance Targets headings trigger disabled-policy mismatch findings.
issues.title: Pseudo target headings cause false policy mismatch
issues.reason: Declaration detection does not apply the parser's fence and HTML-comment exclusions.

issues.claim: Descriptor markers need not immediately precede their functions.
issues.title: Descriptor discovery weakens marker adjacency
issues.reason: Pending markers survive intervening blank and comment lines despite the closed descriptor contract requiring immediate precedence.

evidence_requests.gap: Reachability of the discarded performanceSettings error through an actual sharedOperationRunner construction path remains unproven, and prior investigator tests did not match the failure signature.
evidence_requests.requested_evidence: Create or strengthen an executable Go _test.go reproducer in the approved private workspace that constructs the production shared operation runner through a real caller path using invalid effective performance settings.
evidence_requests.required_observation: The test must show either that runner construction or operation execution proceeds without returning the invalid performance configuration error, or that an upstream production guard deterministically rejects it before the runner is created.
evidence_requests.control_requirement: Use a control case with valid performance settings through the same caller path and assert that no operation side effect occurs before the invalid-settings result is observed.
